nodes.name: Read Mock Marketing Data
nodes.notes: Point this at your own copy of automation/mock-marketing-data-template.csv imported into Google Sheets. See SETUP_GUIDE.md.

nodes.name: Build Fallback Narrative
nodes.notes: Always runs, always produces a usable brief with zero external dependency — the safety net if the free Gemini API call fails or rate-limits.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [ { parts: [ { text: `Write a short (120-160 word) morning marketing brief for a Digital Marketing Director, in a direct, confident tone. Today's metrics: spend ₹${$json.spend}, revenue ₹${$json.revenue}, blended ROAS ${$json.roas}x (${$json.roas_delta_pct}% vs yesterday), ${$json.leads} leads, budget pacing at ${$json.budget_pacing_pct}% of plan. Anomalies: ${$json.anomalies.length ? $json.anomalies.map(a => a.channel + ' at ' + a.roas + 'x').join('; ') : 'none detected'}. End with exactly 3 numbered recommended actions.` } ] } ], generationConfig: { maxOutputTokens: 400 } }) }}

nodes.name: Ask Gemini for AI Narrative
nodes.notes: Free tier — requires a Gemini API key from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com/apikey), no payment method needed. Requires an HTTP Query Auth credential named 'Gemini API' with query param name 'key' = your Gemini API key. If this call fails or is rate-limited, the IF node below falls back to the free template narrative — see SETUP_GUIDE.md.

meta.description: MarkOS AI Module 11 (Reporting & Dashboard Engine) — daily automated morning brief. Pulls sample marketing data, computes metrics, asks Gemini's free-tier API to write the narrative, and falls back to a rule-based narrative if that call fails. A real, importable n8n workflow accompanying the MarkOS AI portfolio project.
